description: This header file declares the interface for WiFi service management in a C-based project. It includes function prototypes for initializing, creating, starting, stopping, updating, and handling events for WiFi services and nodes. It also defines related data types and external dependencies.

methods.name: public_service_init
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi service with the provided service structure.

methods.name: public_service_create_nodes
methods.description: Creates WiFi nodes based on radio and capability configurations.

methods.name: public_service_delete_nodes
methods.description: Deletes all WiFi nodes associated with the service.

methods.name: public_service_update
methods.description: Updates the WiFi service configuration or state.

methods.name: public_service_event
methods.description: Handles events related to the WiFi service.

methods.name: public_open_node_start
methods.description: Starts the Open mode operation on a WiFi service node.

methods.name: public_open_node_stop
methods.description: Stops the Open mode operation on a WiFi service node.

methods.name: public_open_node_update
methods.description: Updates the Open mode configuration or state of a node.

methods.name: public_open_node_event
methods.description: Processes events for a WiFi node in Open mode.

methods.name: public_secure_node_start
methods.description: Starts the Secure mode operation on a WiFi service node.

methods.name: public_secure_node_stop
methods.description: Stops the Secure mode operation on a WiFi service node.

methods.name: public_secure_node_update
methods.description: Updates the Secure mode configuration or state of a node.

methods.name: public_secure_node_event
methods.description: Processes events for a WiFi node in Secure mode.
